name: Fusō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fusō town emblem in navy: a broken ring enclosing a stylised device of a vertical bar and curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Fusō, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1967.

features.role: Fusō town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a stylised device of a vertical bar and curved strokes
